To formalize the triangle inequality theorem in Lean 4, we start by defining points and lines that form a triangle, then assert that the sum of the lengths of any two sides is greater than the length of the remaining side.

```lean4
theorem triangle_inequality (a b c : Point) (AB BC AC : Line) (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) :
  (|(a─b)| + |(b─c)|) > |(a─c)| ∧ (|(a─b)| + |(a─c)|) > |(b─c)| ∧ (|(b─c)| + |(a─c)|) > |(a─b)| := by sorry
```
